newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi mulling delisting from six Japan bourses.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi mulling delisting from six Japan bourses.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp on Wednesday confirmed a newspaper report that it is considering delisting from six regional bourses in Japan to cut costs.
"Although we are considering the measure, we have not set any time schedule for the move," a company spokesman said.
The company's shares would continue to be listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Osaka Securities Exchange, a company spokesman said.
The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its Wednesday edition that the firm would be able to save more than 100 million yen a year through the move.
